data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 白无垢与庭前落叶
data.description: 神社庭前的婚礼准备间，爱瑠身穿纯白白无垢，双手轻轻托住层叠袖口。她发现一片小叶子落在衣摆，俯身把它拾起，随即为自己的短暂分心羞涩一笑；白色织纹在柔和日光里清楚可见。
data.action: 轻托婚礼衣袖，拾起落在白色衣摆上的小叶子。
data.promptProse: In the shrine's courtyard-facing preparation room, Eru Chitanda gently holds her layered shiromuku sleeves, then bends to pick a small leaf from the hem. Her white bridal ornament stays neat as she smiles shyly at the brief distraction. The medium portrait includes the brocade obi and floor beside the doorway. Soft courtyard daylight reveals woven white motifs and the leaf's outline, with gentle overlapping sleeve shadows preserving the kimono layers.
